message: Relation field "Post.author": @relation argument "onDelete" is not supported; Prisma 8 enforces no referential actions on MongoDB. The Prisma 6 client emulates them, so removing "onDelete: Cascade" also changes the Prisma 6 app: its client stops applying Cascade and falls back to its default action for this relation. Handle related documents in application code, then remove "onDelete".

Relation field "Comment.author": @relation argument "onUpdate" is not supported; Prisma 8 enforces no referential actions on MongoDB. The Prisma 6 client emulates them, so removing "onUpdate: Cascade" also changes the Prisma 6 app: its client stops applying Cascade and falls back to its default action for this relation. Handle related documents in application code, then remove "onUpdate".

Relation field "Like.user": @relation argument "map" is not supported; it names a foreign key constraint, and MongoDB has none. Remove "map"; the Prisma 6 app has no foreign key on MongoDB either, so nothing changes there.
